records.label: A900-01 · Two trains, four shared tags — identity holds
records.status: Identity holds active — no register values applied
records.detail: The register (PFD-0900 / LST-001) is a densification train — T-901 → H-901 → C-901 → RC-901 roll compactor → M-901 mill → SC-901 screener → PK-901 cartridge filler → W-901 → SE-901, with DC-901 / FN-901 area extraction. The model (V162 / V163) is a technology-neutral pelletization line — TR-901 → H-901 → F-901 → PG-901 → SC-901 cooling / classification → PK-901 collection package, with RB-901, DC-901 local capture and CP-901 — built without the FEED-PFD-0900 package. Four tags coincide with different meanings; QFL placed H-901, SC-901, PK-901 and DC-901 on identity hold on 2026-09-20, so their six approved rows (materials, inerting basis, product specification) are listed as held and not applied. Seven register items (T-901, C-901, RC-901, M-901, W-901, SE-901, FN-901) have no model record; five model items (TR-901, F-901, PG-901, RB-901, CP-901) have no register identity.
records.action: Reconcile the two trains by MoC on FEED-PFD-0900 — either adopt the pelletization line and retire the densification tags, or model the register train — then lift or convert the holds; until then the model A-900 is a layout placeholder.

records.label: A900-02 · Product acceptance criterion and mechanism
records.detail: D-A900-01 records the acceptance criterion as NOT DEFINED: "1.6 g/mL pellets" does not say whether it is ribbon envelope, granule or packed-cartridge density, and a 1.6 g/mL envelope on a 2.1 g/cm³ carbon leaves ≈ 0.15 cm³/g pore volume — incompatible with a physisorption carbon (0.5–1.0 cm³/g). RC-901 is approved as volume-limited (0.2–1.5 m³/h at 30–200 kg/m³ bulk density: bulk density governs, not mass rate). The model's PG-901 is explicitly a "technology HOLD" envelope.
records.action: Close REP-023's five design-basis items — density definition, product-rate basis, potassium form and ignition sensitivity, A-800 discharge cooling responsibility, inerting extent — then select the densification technology and size the train.

records.label: A900-03 · Product rate basis
records.status: Basis withdrawn — three rates on record
records.detail: Three rates are on record: 28 / 26 kg/h (Narrative capacity table), 44.91 / 42.67 kg/h (MEB V2.0 / REP-019 after 0.95 densification yield) and the DBM V2.0 packed product 625 / 812 kg/d nominal / design (≈ 26 / 34 kg/h). D-A900-01 withdrew the RC-901 feed rate; D-A900-02 approves the DBM V2.0 packed-product rate as the T-901 feed basis. The A-800 → A-900 product handoff is the interface IF-A800-PRODUCT.
records.action: Restate the A-900 rate once on DBM V2.0 in the Narrative and MEB; carry the 0.95 densification yield and the reject stream explicitly.

records.label: A900-04 · Reactive hazard, inerting and dust extraction
records.detail: D-A900-01 approves the REP-023 safeguard statement for RC-901 / M-901: residual potassium form (metallic, K₂O / KOH or bound) unresolved, ignition-sensitive temperature unmeasured, A-800 discharge temperature and cooling responsibility to be assigned. D-A900-02 adopts the PFD-0900 inerting reading — T-901 argon-blanketed, AR902 purge to the compaction enclosure "as required", AR903 to filling, enclosed handling at slight negative pressure via DC-901 / FN-901. The model reserves the three argon takeoffs as positively blinded branches (IF-A900-AR901 … 903) and models DC-901 as a local capture on PG-901 without FN-901.
records.action: Resolve the potassium form (REP-022 / REP-023) and the ignition sensitivity, then fix the inerting extent (which enclosures, which purge) and the extraction philosophy (local vs area) before the dust-hazard assessment; connect the argon branches when the train is settled.

records.label: A900-05 · Product release and filling
records.detail: D-A900-02 approves product release per FEED-QA-SPC-001 (rGO-BCK specification, stream 804, draft V0.1) with hold point HP-1, and a checkweigher verification before sealing (W-901). Both are recorded against the register's cartridge filler PK-901; the model's PK-901 is a collection / packaging envelope, so the rows are held. W-901 and SE-901 have no model record; the model's accepted / reject / dust boundaries are the interfaces IF-A900-PRODUCT / REJECT / DUST.
records.action: Issue FEED-QA-SPC-001 beyond draft with the package format decided; then map release, checkweigh and seal functions onto whichever train is adopted and lift the PK-901 hold.

records.label: A900-06 · Materials of construction
records.status: Ruled for the register train — held on shared tags
records.detail: D-A900-MOC applies MAT-002 to the eleven register items: 316L electropolished, grounded and bonded product-contact surfaces with hard-facing (M-055) and conductive grounded 316L or conductive PTFE-lined ducting for DC-901 / FN-901 (M-056); MDL-001 304L superseded. Seven of the eleven rulings sit on register-only items without a model record; the four on shared tags are held. The model-only items TR-901, F-901, PG-901, RB-901 and CP-901 have no material at all.
records.action: Once the train is reconciled, extend MAT-002 to the adopted model items and apply the rulings; keep the M-055 / M-056 basis for whichever equipment survives.

records.label: A900-07 · Layout, supports and access
records.detail: V162 relocated the line beside the cooled PY-801 outlet and removed the former long transfer route and its three walkway conflicts; V163 added floor-connected skids, a feeder frame, a dust-filter frame, a reject tray and a control-cabinet plinth, all provisional (vendor loads, member sizing, anchors and vibration isolation unverified). The model places fire point FE-901 at the future filling / dispatch approach; no emergency station is assigned to A-900. The packaged-product route to dispatch is not modelled.
records.action: Keep the footprint as the reserved envelope; qualify supports and access once a technology is selected; add an emergency station and the dispatch route to the plant-wide access and fire-safety reviews.
